info.title: City4Christ API
info.description:
Auth foundation API. Use only test data on preview deployments. Interactive requests execute against this server and can create or change accounts. Public signup is closed by default. Email and Google availability depend on deployment configuration.

Keep access tokens in memory. Swagger Authorize accepts the access token only, without the Bearer prefix. Refresh cookies are HttpOnly and browser-managed; Swagger cannot manually set Cookie headers. This same-origin UI sends credentials automatically. Browser-origin checks still apply.

OTP: eight digits, ten minutes, five attempts, sixty-second resend cooldown. Limits: auth IP 60/min; register/resend 5 per account/15min; login 10 per account/15min; verify 20 per account/15min.

post.description: Browser requests must include credentials: "include" and an allowed Origin. JSON bodies are capped at 16 KiB; unknown fields and null objects are rejected. Creates an unverified account and queues an encrypted OTP email. Does not log in. Signup is disabled by default; the free Render Blueprint has no email worker, so delivery needs separate configuration.

Browser requests must include credentials: "include" and an allowed Origin. JSON bodies are capped at 16 KiB; unknown fields and null objects are rejected. OTP lifetime: ten minutes; single use; five attempts per issued code. Successful verification does not create a session.

Returns the same 202 response for unknown, verified, or cooldown accounts. An eligible new code invalidates the previous code.

Browser requests must include credentials: "include" and an allowed Origin. JSON bodies are capped at 16 KiB; unknown fields and null objects are rejected. Requires a verified email and a local password. Returns a ten-minute access token and a thirty-day refresh cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: Host-only __Host-c4c_refresh cookie; Secure, HttpOnly, Path=/; SameSite=Lax by default or None for configured cross-site clients. Browser manages it automatically. Refresh rotates it; logout clears it. Never put refresh tokens in JSON or browser storage.

post.description: Requires an allowed Origin and the refresh cookie. No JSON body. Rotates refresh token atomically; the original thirty-day absolute expiry is retained. Reusing any consumed token revokes the entire session, including its access tokens. Serialize refresh requests. Failed refresh clears the cookie.

get.description: Access JWT must be sent in Authorization: Bearer. Tokens in query parameters or cookies are not accepted. Session revocation is checked on every request.

patch.summary: Update own profile or directory visibility
patch.description: Active verified Bearer session and allowed Origin required. Actor comes only from the session. Maximum 30 write attempts per account per minute. 16 KiB JSON body cap; unknown/security fields rejected. Omitted/null fields are unchanged. Concurrent different-field edits are preserved; same-field edits use last committed value. This preference does not expose a directory yet.

400.description: Unknown field, invalid field type or malformed JSON

422.description: Invalid profile fields or empty patch; see error.fields

get.description: Creates single-use state, nonce and PKCE S256 challenge. Sets a Secure, HttpOnly browser-binding cookie; SameSite follows the cross-site cookie configuration. Navigate to data.url in this browser; a fetch alone does not complete Google login. New signup obeys REGISTRATION_ENABLED. Google-only accounts have no local password. Optional returnTo enables browser completion: callback sets the refresh cookie and redirects to the stored frontend page, without access credentials in the URL or response body. The frontend then POSTs /auth/refresh with credentials. Binding cookie uses SameSite=None when cross-site cookies are enabled, otherwise Lax.

Set-Cookie.description: Secure, HttpOnly __Host-c4c_oidc binding cookie, Path=/; SameSite follows cross-site cookie configuration. Preserve for callback.

302.description: Navigate to Google; binding cookie is set.

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: Optional absolute HTTPS frontend auth.html URL on an allowed origin, without query or fragment. Stored with the single-use flow; callback does not trust a supplied return URL.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Use 1 together with returnTo for top-level browser navigation directly to Google. Omit to receive JSON data.url.

post.description: Requires an allowed Origin and an active Bearer session created within five minutes of login. Explicitly link Google to this account; email must match and be verified. Refreshing a token does not count as a new login. Optional returnTo enables browser completion: callback sets the refresh cookie and redirects to the stored frontend page, without access credentials in the URL or response body. The frontend then POSTs /auth/refresh with credentials. Binding cookie uses SameSite=None when cross-site cookies are enabled, otherwise Lax.

get.description: Google redirects here with code and state. Requires the matching browser-binding cookie and consumes the flow once. Validates signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce and verified email. Never automatically links matching local email: account_link_required means sign in locally and explicitly link. Returns JSON tokens and a refresh cookie, not a frontend redirect. A frontend completion page can subsequently call refresh using the cookie. The browser-binding cookie is cleared.

302.description: For a flow started with returnTo, redirect to the stored allowed frontend page. Success sets the refresh cookie; errors append a known auth_error code. No tokens appear in the redirect URL.

get.description: Process liveness; does not query PostgreSQL.
Checks PostgreSQL connectivity; does not prove provider delivery or validate every migration.

Public metadata only. Sorted by publication time descending, then ID descending. Drafts (no publication timestamp) and future publications are hidden. Unknown or repeated query parameters and malformed cursors return 422. An empty catalog returns data: [] and nextCursor: "". Video links, when present, are canonical YouTube URLs. Editor writes use /admin/sermons; managed series resources and media hosting are deferred.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Literal case-insensitive substring search across title and summary; % and _ are not wildcards.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation from meta.nextCursor. Keep the same filters across pages.

nextCursor.description: Empty string marks the final page.

get.description: Public metadata for a published sermon. Draft, future, missing and malformed IDs all return 404. No raw media files or private editor data are returned.

Location.description: Editor detail URL for the draft.

draftWithoutVideo.summary: Create a draft without an optional video

post.description: Requires a verified active Bearer session with an editor role from PostgreSQL, an allowed Origin and application/json. Always creates a draft; does not publish. Creation and actor/version audit are atomic. Mutations are limited to 60 per editor per minute. No role or publication state can be supplied here. Validation errors identify the field in error.fields. Response-only fields (id, publishedAt) are not accepted in request bodies.

get.description: Editor-only access to drafts, scheduled and published sermons with their current version. Public visitors must use /sermons instead.

409.description: Stale version; reload the latest editor detail before editing.

publish.summary: Publish version 1; replace with the current version

patch.description: Requires an allowed Origin and current version. A stale version returns 409 without changing the sermon or audit. status=published publishes now and preserves the original publication date if already published. status=draft unpublishes immediately. status=scheduled requires future publishAt and hides the sermon until that instant. Each successful edit increments version and writes an audit event atomically. Role revocation applies without obtaining a new token. Omitted fields are preserved exactly; normalization applies only to supplied fields. Validation errors identify the field in error.fields. Response-only fields (id, publishedAt) are not accepted in request bodies.

get.description: Verified active access_administrator session required. System administrators do not inherit delegation rights. Maximum 30 access-management requests per administrator per minute. Mutations require an allowed Origin and JSON body (16 KiB maximum). The API cannot grant or revoke privileged administrator, finance or care roles. Ministry scopes are operator-registered groundwork; no ministry module exists yet.

get.description: Verified active Bearer session required. The caller may keep their own profile hidden and still browse visible members. Every page filters verified accounts with directoryVisible=true. Returns only id, firstName and lastName; no email, credentials, verification flags, roles or hidden-profile details. Search is literal, case-insensitive substring matching over firstName + space + lastName; % and _ are ordinary characters. Stable UUID ascending order, independent of names; pagination is live, not a frozen snapshot. 60 requests/account/minute and 120 requests/IP/minute. Unknown or repeated parameters are rejected. Opt out through PATCH /api/v1/me. No member detail-by-ID route is exposed.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Name search only. Trimmed; at most 200 characters; no control characters. Email is not searched.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Reuse nextCursor with the same trimmed search query. Start a fresh search when query changes.

200.description: Visible member page; data is an empty array if no matches.

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked or unverified session

422.description: Invalid/unknown/repeated parameters or cursor; see error.fields

429.description: Directory account or IP rate limit exceeded; Retry-After supplied

password.description: At least 15 Unicode characters, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Preserved exactly.
Existing local password; Google-only accounts cannot use password login.

code.description: Eight-digit OTP. Wrong, expired, consumed or exhausted codes are rejected.

accessToken.description: Ten-minute JWT. Keep in memory and use Authorization: Bearer.

directoryVisible.description: Directory listing opt-in. Defaults to false for existing and new accounts.

version.description: Required current version from the editor detail response.

publishAt.description: Required future UTC instant when status is scheduled; forbidden with other statuses. Microsecond precision.

SermonUpdateInput.description: Supply version plus at least one field to change. Omitted or null optional fields are ignored; use empty strings to clear optional text/video fields. PublishedAt and roles cannot be supplied.

scope.description: Empty for content_editor. For ministry_leader, a canonical nonzero UUID registered by an operator in access_scopes.

reason.description: Nonblank reason recorded in the audit trail.

ProfileUpdate.description: At least one non-null supported field required. Null means omitted. Names are trimmed and reject control characters. No email, password, verification or role changes.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor; empty when no more results. Reuse with the same trimmed query. Visibility is rechecked on every page.

400.description: Malformed JSON, invalid/expired OTP, or invalid Google callback.

403.description: Origin forbidden, insufficient permissions, registration closed, or email unverified.

409.description: Email unavailable, explicit Google linking required, or identity conflict.

429.description: Account or IP rate limit reached.

503.description: Service unavailable or authentication/provider configuration missing.
